y-m-16-08.title: Kuedza chirevo chaHajun 'kuwedzera nhamba imwe chete kunosiya zvakafanana'
y-m-16-08.topic: Kuenzanisa hukuru hwezvikamu: kuchinja nhamba iri pamusoro nomuparadzanisi pamwe chete
y-m-16-08.goal: Tonga chirevo chokuti kuwedzera nhamba imwe chete panhamba iri pamusoro nomuparadzanisi kunosiya hukuru hwechikamu husingachinji nokutarisa kuti mienzaniso iri zvikamu zvemhando ipi, ratidza nemienzaniso inopikisa kuti hukuru hunochinja sei kuzvikamu zviri pasi pe 1 nezviri pamusoro pe 1, uye wobva wafungidzira zvinoitika kuchikamu kana nhamba inowedzerwa yaitwa huru zvikuru.
y-m-16-08.material: Hajun akawedzera 2 panhamba iri pamusoro nomuparadzanisi zvezvikamu 4/4 (kota ina) ne 7/7 (nomwe nomwe). Zvakava 6/6 ne 9/9, uye zvose zvi 1, saka hukuru hwakaramba huri hwakafanana. Hajun akati, “Kunyange ukawedzera nhamba imwe chete panhamba iri pamusoro nomuparadzanisi wechikamu, hukuru hwechikamu hunoramba huri hwakafanana. Zvakafanana nokuparadzanisa nenhamba imwe chete kana uchidzikisa!”

y-m-16-08.s.s1.hint.1: Sarudza chikamu chimwe chine nhamba iri pamusoro nomuparadzanisi zvakasiyana, wedzera nhamba imwe chete, uye uenzanise pamberi napashure.
y-m-16-08.s.s1.o.a: Mienzaniso yose miviri yakarurama, saka hukuru huchagara hwakafanana, uye hapana nyaya yokuyedza zvakawanda
y-m-16-08.s.s1.r.a: Pane mienzaniso miviri chete yakarurama, uye hauna kutarisa kuti mienzaniso miviri iri zvikamu zvemhando ipi.
y-m-16-08.s.s1.o.b: Tinofanira kuyedzawo mamwe marudzi ezvikamu kunze kwaakayedzwa naHajun
y-m-16-08.s.s1.r.b: Wakatarisa kuti mienzaniso iri zvikamu zvemhando ipi uye wakafunga marudzi asati ayedzwa.
y-m-16-08.s.s1.o.c: Haugoni kuenzanisa hukuru hwechikamu nokuwedzera panhamba iri pamusoro nomuparadzanisi, saka haugoni kutonga
y-m-16-08.s.s1.r.c: Unogona kuverenga nokuenzanisa zvikamu zvepamberi nezvapashure pokuwedzera. Hazvisi zvokuti hazvigoni kuenzaniswa.
y-m-16-08.s.s1.o.d: Kuwedzera kuverenga kunochinja nhamba, saka hukuru hwechikamu hunoratidzika huchichinja, uye chirevo chaHajun chakanganisa
y-m-16-08.s.s1.r.d: Mumuenzaniso waHajun hukuru hwakaramba huri hwakafanana. Kuti uve nechokwadi pazvinhu zvose, kuyedza kwakawanda kuri kudikanwa.
y-m-16-08.s.s1.explain: 4/4 ne 7/7 zvose zvikamu zvine kukosha 1, saka kunyange ukawedzera nhamba imwe chete, inoramba iri 1. Sezvo chikamu chine nhamba iri pamusoro nomuparadzanisi zvakasiyana (se 2/3) chisati chayedzwa, uchiri kunyanya kuti 'zvinogara zvakadaro.'
y-m-16-08.s.s2.prompt: Pachikamu a/b chine nhamba iri pamusoro a nomuparadzanisi b, gadzira mienzaniso 2 yakasiyana umo (a+n)/(b+n), yakagadzirwa nokuwedzera nhamba imwe chete n panhamba iri pamusoro nomuparadzanisi, ine hukuru hwakasiyana na a/b. Mumwe unofanira kuva chikamu chiri pasi pe 1 (a idiki kupfuura b) uye mumwe chikamu chiri pamusoro pe 1 (a yakakura kupfuura b). (a, b, ne n inhamba dzechisikigo dze 20 kana kushoma.)

y-m-16-02.title: Kutarisa huwandu hwemvura yasara mushure mekudira mumakapu
y-m-16-02.topic: Kuparadzanisa ma decimal: remainder mukuparadzanisa ne remainder
y-m-16-02.goal: Mukuparadzanisa ma decimal apo quotient inowanikwa kusvika panzvimbo ye natural number, tsvaga mutsara apo hukuru hwe remainder husina kururama, sarudza nzira dzekutarisa kuti remainder yakarurama here, uye ugadzire dambudziko rako rekuparadzanisa rine remainder.
y-m-16-02.material: Doyun anoda kudira 8.6 L yemvura mumakapu e0.4 L, achizadza kapu imwe neimwe zvizere. Akawana quotient kusvika panzvimbo ye natural number chete uye akawanawo remainder (huwandu hwemvura yasara). Pazasi ndiyo mhinduro yaDoyun. (Verenga nhamba dzemitsara kubva ku1.)
y-m-16-02.thinking.1: Kuenzanisa nzira dzekutarisa kuti mhedzisiro yakarurama here
y-m-16-02.prereq.0: Kuwedzera nhamba ine decimal place imwe ne natural number
y-m-16-02.prereq.1: Kuparadzanisa ma natural number ne remainder (quotient, remainder, remainder idiki kupfuura divisor)
y-m-16-02.s.s1.prompt: Sarudza mutsara wekutanga usina kururama mumhinduro yaDoyun.
y-m-16-02.s.s1.hint.0: Teedzera kuti mutsara mumwe nemumwe wakabva sei pamutsara wapfuura chaipo, uye uratidze mitsara apo nhamba dzakachinjwa.
y-m-16-02.s.s1.hint.1: Kana pane mutsara apo nhamba dzakachinjwa, funga kuti quotient ne remainder mushure mekuchinja zvinogona kushandiswa sezvazviri se quotient ne remainder yekuparadzanisa kwekutanga 8.6 ÷ 0.4 here.
y-m-16-02.s.s1.line.0: Mu 8.6 ÷ 0.4, tsvaga quotient kusvika panzvimbo ye natural number chete uye utsvage remainder zvakare.
y-m-16-02.s.s1.line.1: Wedzera dividend 8.6 ne divisor 0.4 zvose ne10 kuti ushandure kuita 86 ÷ 4.
y-m-16-02.s.s1.line.3: Saka quotient ye 8.6 ÷ 0.4 ndi21 uye remainder ndi2.
y-m-16-02.s.s1.line.4: Mhinduro: makapu 21 anozadzwa zvizere uye 2 L yemvura inosara.
y-m-16-02.s.s1.explain: Nzvimbo yekutanga isina kururama imutsara 4. Sezvo nhamba mbiri dzose dzakawedzerwa ne10 mumutsara 2, remainder 2 ye 86 ÷ 4 ndi 'nguva 10 remainder yekutanga.' Saka remainder ye 8.6 ÷ 0.4 ndi0.2. Kuverenga kwakarurama kusvika pamutsara 3, uye mutsara 5 hauna kururama nekuti unotevera mutsara 4.
y-m-16-02.s.s2.prompt: Sarudza nzira dzose dzinogona kutarisa kuti mhinduro yaDoyun ‘makapu 21, 2 L yemvura yasara’ yakarurama here.
y-m-16-02.s.s2.hint.0: Rangarira nzira yawakashandisa kutarisa kuparadzanisa ma natural number ne remainder.
y-m-16-02.s.s2.hint.1: Edza nzira imwe neimwe iwe pachako nenhamba dzaDoyun uye utarise kuti pane chinoita sechisina kunaka here.
y-m-16-02.s.s2.o.a: Akazadza 21, saka enzanisa kuti ndeipi yakakura, 21 kana 8.6
y-m-16-02.s.s2.r.a: 0.4 L ikapu diki kupfuura 1 L, saka hazvisi zvisina kunaka kuti huwandu hwemakapu huve hukuru kupfuura huwandu hwemvura (nhamba inoratidza L). Kuenzanisa uku hakugoni kuratidza kukanganisa.
y-m-16-02.s.s2.o.b: Enzanisa kuti 2 L yemvura yasara yakakura kupfuura hukuru hwekapu imwe, 0.4 L here
y-m-16-02.s.s2.r.b: Izvi zvakashandisa mutemo wekuti remainder inofanira kuva diki kupfuura divisor. Inokuudzawo kuti waigona kuzadza makapu akawanda nemvura yasara here.
y-m-16-02.s.s2.o.c: Verenga 86 ÷ 4 zvakare uye utarise kuti 21 remainder 2 yakarurama
y-m-16-02.s.s2.r.c: Izvi zvakadzokorora kuverenga kumwe chete. 86 ÷ 4 pachayo yakarurama, saka kukanganisa kunoenderana ne decimal point hakuoneki nenzira iyi.
y-m-16-02.s.s2.o.d: Verenga 0.4 × 21 + 2 uye utarise kuti inoenzana ne8.6 here
y-m-16-02.s.s2.r.d: Izvi zvakashandisa hukama hwe divisor × quotient + remainder = dividend.
y-m-16-02.s.s2.explain: Remainder inofanira kuva diki kupfuura divisor, asi 2 L yakakura kupfuura 0.4 L. Zvakare, 0.4 × 21 + 2 = 10.4, iyo yakasiyana ne8.6. Yaifanira kuva 0.4 × 21 + 0.2 = 8.6, saka remainder ndi0.2 L. Kuverenga 86 ÷ 4 zvakare kunongodzokorora mhinduro imwe chete, saka hakugoni kuwana kukanganisa uku.
y-m-16-02.s.s3.prompt: Gadzira dambudziko rinova nyore kukanganisa kana rakagadziriswa nenzira imwe chete naDoyun. Dividend a ne divisor b ndenhamba dzine decimal place imwe chete zvakanyanya, a inofanira kuva 1 kana kupfuura, uye b inofanira kuva huru kupfuura 0 uye pasi pe1. Kana quotient ye a ÷ b yawanikwa kusvika pa natural number, gadzira matambudziko 3 akasiyana apo quotient iri kubva ku10 kusvika ku40 uye remainder isiri 0. (Siya 8.6 ÷ 0.4 iri mudambudziko.)

y-m-16-02.s.s3.hint.1: Kana wasarudza munhu anogona kusarudzwa, shandura kuita kuparadzanisa ma natural number nekuwedzera nhamba mbiri dzose ne10, uye utarise kuti remainder ndi0 here.

y-m-16-03.title: Kuunganidza ma fraction ari pakati pe0.6 ne3/4
y-m-16-03.topic: Kuenzanisa hukuru hwema fraction nema decimal: nhamba dziri pakati penhamba mbiri
y-m-16-03.goal: Ongorora nzira dzakawanda dzekuenzanisa hukuru hwema fraction nema decimal, uye utsvage, kuti zvienderane nemamiriro, ma fraction asingaderedzwi ari pakati penhamba mbiri.
y-m-16-03.material:
Seoyeon anoda kuunganidza makadhi e fraction ari pakati pe0.6 ne3/4 (matatu pamana). Kutanga, shamwari nhatu dzakataura imwe neimwe, nenzira yadzo, kuti 7/12 (nomwe pagumi nemaviri) yakakura kana diki kupfuura 0.6.
Siu: “Mu 7/12 numerator 7 yakakura kupfuura 6 iri mu 0.6, saka 7/12 yakakura.”
Hayoon: “Kana ukaparadzanisa 7 ne12 unowana 0.58333…. Zvichienzaniswa ne0.6, 7/12 idiki.”
Dohyun: “Ndakashandura 0.6 kuita 3/5 ndikaiisa pa common denominator ye60 ne7/12. Ndi35/60 ne36/60, saka 0.6 yakakura.”
Jihu: “Kana ukashandura 0.6 kuita twelfths, ndi7.2/12. Kuenzanisa ma numerator 7 ne7.2, 7/12 idiki.”

y-m-16-03.s.s1.prompt: Sarudza nzira dzose dzakakodzera dzekuenzanisa hukuru hwe7/12 ne0.6.

y-m-16-03.s.s1.hint.1: Sarudza nzira imwe uye uishandise iwe pachako ku7/12 ne0.6, uye uenzanise kuti inosangana nemhedzisiro dzenzira dzimwe here.
y-m-16-03.s.s1.o.a: Siu: enzanisa numerator 7 ne6 iri mu 0.6
y-m-16-03.s.s1.r.a: Izvi zvakaenzanisa zvakananga numerator ye fraction nedigit ye decimal. Fraction ine denominator 12 ne0.6 ine denominator 10 hazvisi muchikamu chimwe chete, saka hazvigoni kuenzaniswa nenzira iyi.
y-m-16-03.s.s1.o.b: Hayoon: paradzanisa 7 ne12 kuti ushandure kuita decimal uye uenzanise
y-m-16-03.s.s1.r.b: Izvi zvakashandura fraction kuita decimal kuti ive fomu imwe chete uye zvakaenzanisa. Zvinokosha zvakare kuti nzvimbo dzakatarisirwa kure zvakakwana kuti musiyano pakati pe0.583… ne0.6 uve pachena.
y-m-16-03.s.s1.o.c: Dohyun: shandura 0.6 kuita 3/5, tsvaga common denominator, wobva waenzanisa ma numerator
y-m-16-03.s.s1.r.c: Izvi zvakashandura decimal kuita fraction uye zvakaenzanisa mushure mekuita ma denominator akafanana.
y-m-16-03.s.s1.o.d: Jihu: shandura 0.6 kuita fraction ine denominator 12 uye uenzanise ma numerator
y-m-16-03.s.s1.r.d: Kunyangwe numerator isiri natural number, unogona kuenzanisa kana ma denominator akafanana. Hazvina kurasirwa nekuti fomu isingazivikanwe.

y-m-16-03.s.s2.o.b: Hapana. Nhamba mbiri dziri padhuze zvikuru, saka hapana chinogona kukodzera pakati pazvo
y-m-16-03.s.s2.r.b: Shandura makosha enhamba mbiri kuita ma decimal. Unoona mukaha pakati pe0.6 ne0.75 here?

y-m-16-03.s.s2.r.c: Kunze kwenhamba iri pakati, pane ma fraction senge 7/10 ne2/3 ari pakati. Enzanisa makosha rimwe rimwe.

y-m-16-03.s.s2.r.d: Ma fraction nema decimal anongosiyana mufomu; inhamba dziri pa number line imwe chete. Kana ukadzishandura kuita fomu imwe, unogona kutaura kuti chii chiri pakati.
y-m-16-03.s.s2.explain: Kana ukaita denominator huru, senge 100, 1000, …, unogona kuramba uchiwana nhamba nyowani pakati pe0.6 ne0.75, saka dzakawanda zvisingaperi. Muhanho inotevera uchatsvaga chete ma fraction asingaderedzwi ane denominator ye20 kana pasi.

y-m-16-07.title: Kuwana mafraction anopera panzvimbo yechipiri yedhesimali
y-m-16-07.topic: Hukama pakati pemafraction nemadhesimali: mafraction anopera kana akanyorwa sedhesimali
y-m-16-07.goal: Sarudza, uchibatanidza nedenominator, nzvimbo iyo nhamba dzakatevera ponti yedhesimali dzinopera kana fraction yanyorwa sedhesimali, uye gadzira mafraction anokodzera mamiriro kuti utaure mutemo nezvemadenominator ane.
y-m-16-07.material: Soyul akati, “Kana ukanyora fraction sedhesimali, denominator kana yakakura, inova refu zvakanyanya kuseri kweponti yedhesimali.” (Kana nhamba dziri kuseri kweponti yedhesimali dzichienderera zvisingapere, inonzi ndiyo refu zvikuru.) Uchaongorora kana chirevo chaSoyul chakarurama uye ugadzire mafraction anopera panzvimbo 2 dzakatevera ponti kana akanyorwa sedhesimali.
y-m-16-07.thinking.2: Kugadzira mienzaniso inokodzera mamiriro uye kuwana mutemo
y-m-16-07.prereq.0: Kunyora sedhesimali nekushandura denominator kuita 10 kana 100
y-m-16-07.s.s1.prompt: Muenzaniso upi unoratidza kuti chirevo chaSoyul hachina kururama?
y-m-16-07.s.s1.hint.0: Nyora chirevo chaSoyul mumutsara mumwe, wobva wafungidzira kuti mafraction maviri anofanira kubuda sei kuti chirevo chisaruramise.
y-m-16-07.s.s1.hint.1: Nyora muenzaniso mumwe nemumwe sedhesimali uye uenzanise kuti hukuru hwedenominator nehurefu kuseri kweponti yedhesimali zvinoenda nzira ipi.
y-m-16-07.s.s1.o.a: 1/3 ne1/4: 1/4, ine denominator huru, inopera se0.25, uye 1/3 inoenderera isingapere
y-m-16-07.s.s1.r.a: Iyo ine denominator diki chaizvo ndiyo refu, saka wawana muenzaniso unopesana nechirevo.
y-m-16-07.s.s1.o.b: 1/2 ne1/4: 1/4, ine denominator huru, i0.25 ine nzvimbo mbiri, saka ndiyo refu
y-m-16-07.s.s1.r.b: Iyo ine denominator huru yakabuda refu, saka muenzaniso uyu unotsigira chirevo chaSoyul. Muenzaniso unoratidza kuti chirevo hachina kururama unofanira kubuda neimwe nzira.
y-m-16-07.s.s1.o.c: 1/10 ne1/100: 1/100, ine denominator huru, i0.01 ine nzvimbo mbiri, saka ndiyo refu
y-m-16-07.s.s1.r.c: Iyo ine denominator huru yakabuda refu, saka inoenda nenzira imwe chete nechirevo chaSoyul.
y-m-16-07.s.s1.o.d: 1/5 ne1/7: 1/7, ine denominator huru, inoenderera isingapere se0.142857…, saka ndiyo refu
y-m-16-07.s.s1.r.d: Iyo ine denominator huru ndiyo refu, saka uyu muenzaniso unoenda nenzira imwe chete nechirevo chaSoyul.
y-m-16-07.s.s1.explain: 1/3 = 0.333… inoenderera isina mugumo, asi 1/4 = 0.25, ine muparadzanisi mukuru, inopera panzvimbo mbiri. Kana ine muparadzanisi mudiki ichireba kudaro, chirevo chaSoyul hachina kururama. Mimwe mienzaniso yose inoenda nenzira imwe chete nechirevo, saka haigoni kuva mienzaniso inopikisa.
y-m-16-07.s.s2.prompt: Pasina kashandisi kuverenga, uchitarisa chete kana muparadzanisi unogona kuitwa 10 kana 100, sarudza zvikamu zvose zvinopera panzvimbo mbiri mushure medhesimali.
y-m-16-07.s.s2.hint.0: Pachikamu chega chega, tsvaga kuti nhamba yechisikigo ipi inowanzwa nemuparadzanisi inoita 100.
y-m-16-07.s.s2.hint.1: Kuzvikamu zvine nhamba yakadaro, wanza nhamba iri pamusoro nenhamba imwe chete uye unyore sedhesimali.
y-m-16-07.s.s2.r.a: Muparadzanisi 8 haugoni kuitwa 10 kana 100. Kana ukanyora 3/8 sedhesimali, inoenderera kusvika panzvimbo nhatu mushure medhesimali.
y-m-16-07.s.s2.r.b: Muparadzanisi 20 une nhamba inoita 100 kana ikawanzwa. Unogona kuita muparadzanisi 100 uye kuinyora sedhesimali.
y-m-16-07.s.s2.r.c: Kuna muparadzanisi 15, hapana nhamba yechisikigo inoita 10 kana 100 kana ikawanzwa. Kana yakanyorwa sedhesimali, inoenderera isina mugumo.
y-m-16-07.s.s2.r.d: Kuwanza muparadzanisi 25 ne 4 kunopa 100. Unogona kuwanzawo nhamba iri pamusoro ne 4 uye kuinyora sedhesimali.
y-m-16-07.s.s2.explain: 7/20 = 35/100 = 0.35 ne 9/25 = 36/100 = 0.36 zvinopera panzvimbo mbiri mushure medhesimali. 3/8 ndi 0.375 ine nzvimbo 3, uye 4/15 ndi 0.2666…, inoenderera isina mugumo.
y-m-16-07.s.s3.prompt: Gadzira zvikamu 3 zvakasiyana zvisingaderedzwi a/b zvinopera panzvimbo mbiri chaizvo kana zvakanyorwa sedhesimali. (a inhamba yechisikigo diki kupfuura b, uye muparadzanisi b ndi 50 kana kushoma.)
y-m-16-07.s.s3.hint.0: Tanga wasarudza kuti nhamba dzipi dzaunogona kushandisa semuparadzanisi. Tsvaga nhamba dzinoparadzanisa 100 zvakaenzana.
y-m-16-07.s.s3.hint.1: Nomuparadzanisi wawasarudza, chinja nhamba iri pamusoro uye utarise kana kukosha kwenguva 100 yaro kunoparadzanwa zvakaenzana nomuparadzanisi.
y-m-16-07.s.s3.ok.c1: Nhamba iri pamusoro nomuparadzanisi ndi nhamba dzechisikigo uye chikamu chakarurama.
y-m-16-07.s.s3.fail.c1: Nhamba iri pamusoro a inofanira kuva 1 kana kupfuura uye idiki kupfuura muparadzanisi b, uye b inofanira kuva nhamba yechisikigo ye 50 kana kushoma.

y-m-16-07.s.s3.fail.c3: Hachipere panzvimbo mbiri mushure medhesimali (chinoenderera chisina mugumo, kana chine nzvimbo 3 kana kupfuura).

y-m-16-07.s.s3.fail.c4: Chinopera panzvimbo imwe mushure medhesimali. Tsvaga zvikamu zvine nzvimbo mbiri.
y-m-16-07.s.s3.explain: 1/4 = 0.25, 3/20 = 0.15, 9/25 = 0.36, ne 7/50 = 0.14 zvose zvinopera panzvimbo mbiri chaizvo. 1/2 (0.5) ine nzvimbo imwe, 3/8 (0.375) ine nzvimbo 3, uye 1/3 inoenderera isina mugumo. 6/20 chikamu chinogona kudzikiswa.
y-m-16-07.s.s3.because.prompt: Uchitarisa vaparadzanisi vezvikamu zvawakagadzira, nyora mutsara 1 kana 2 unotaura zvawakawana nezvokuti vaparadzanisi vapi vanopa zvikamu zvinopera panzvimbo mbiri mushure medhesimali.

y-m-16-04.title: Kuverenga kuti mabhokisi ezvipo mangani anogona kusungwa neribhoni
y-m-16-04.topic: Kuparadzanisa ma decimal: kududzira quotient ye decimal kuti ienderane nemamiriro
y-m-16-04.goal: Mumamiriro apo kukosha kwekuparadzanisa (19.5) oga kusingatari mhinduro, tsvaga ruzivo rwaunoda kuziva zvakawanda, uye ugadzire nekutsanangura nyaya apo mhinduro inochinja zvichienderana neruzivo.
y-m-16-04.material: Kusunga bhokisi rimwe rechipo kunoda ribhoni ye0.8 m (kusanganisira hurefu hunoshandiswa kuchisungo). Pane zvimedu zvitatu zveribhoni, zvehurefu 4.5 m, 5.1 m, ne6.0 m. Mudzidzisi akabvunza, “Mabhokisi mangani anogona kusungwa zvose?” Hyoju akaparadzanisa 15.6 m, huwandu hwehurefu hutatu, ne0.8 m, akawana kukosha 19.5, uye akapindura, “Anenge 19.”
y-m-16-04.thinking.1: Kugadzira nyaya apo mhinduro inochinja zvichienderana nefungidziro

y-m-16-04.s.s1.prompt: Usati wavimba nemhinduro yaHyoju ye ‘mabhokisi 19,’ sarudza zvinhu zvose zvaunofanira kutanga wabvunza mudzidzisi.
y-m-16-04.s.s1.hint.0: Kuti upindure ‘angasungwa mangani,’ unofanira kuziva kuti ribhoni rinoshandiswa sei. Fungidzira kuti mhinduro ingachinja here kana nzira yekuriushandisa ichichinja.

y-m-16-04.s.s1.r.a: Kana zvimedu zvakabatanidzwa, unogona kuwedzera hurefu uye kuzvishandisa zvose; kana zvisingagoni kubatanidzwa, unofanira kufunga chimedu chimwe nechimwe zvakaparadzana. Wakacherekedza ruzivo runokanganisa mhinduro.
y-m-16-04.s.s1.o.b: Kuti ribhoni rasara mushure mekusunga mabhokisi rinogona kushandiswa kunge rimwe rekushongedza here
y-m-16-04.s.s1.r.b: Pakushandiswa ribhoni rasara hapana chekuita nehuwandu hwemabhokisi anogona kusungwa. Funga kuti ndiruzivo rwunodiwa kusarudza huwandu here.
y-m-16-04.s.s1.o.c: Kuti pane hurefu hunorasika kana ribhoni rakachekwa nesikisi here
y-m-16-04.s.s1.r.c: Kana hurefu hunorasika pakucheka, huwandu hwemabhokisi anoshandisa 0.8 m rimwe nerimwe hungachinja. Wakacherekedza fungidziro.
y-m-16-04.s.s1.r.d: Mutengo hauna kushandiswa kutsvaga huwandu. Tarisa zvakare chaunoda kutsvaga.
y-m-16-04.s.s1.explain: Zvichienderana nekuti ribhoni rinogona kubatanidzwa here, unogona kushandisa kukosha kwe15.6 ÷ 0.8, kana kuti ungafanira kuparadzanisa chimedu chimwe nechimwe zvakaparadzana. Kuti hurefu hunorasika pakucheka here zvinokanganisawo huwandu. Kuti ribhoni rasara rinoshandiswa pachii nemutengo weribhoni hazvina chekuita nokuti zvingasungwa zvingani.
y-m-16-04.s.s2.prompt: (Iyi ndiyo mhinduro yemudzidzisi kumubvunzo wawakatarisa muhanho yekutanga.) Mudzidzisi akapindura, "Ribhoni haribatanidzwi, uye hapana hurefu hunorasika pakucheka." Sarudza hurefu p, q ne r (m, ne decimal place imwe, imwe neimwe 0.8 m kana kupfuura) hwezvimedu zvitatu, uye ugadzire nyaya 2 dzakasiyana apo huwandu ndi15.6 m uye huwandu hwemabhokisi anosungwa nekucheka chimedu chimwe nechimwe zvakaparadzana huri pasi pe19. y-m-16-01.title: Kuedza 'kana ukawanza nenhamba chero ipi yakafanana' yaHajun
y-m-16-01.topic: Kupatsanura ma decimals: quotient kana nhamba mbiri dzachinjwa pamwe chete
y-m-16-01.goal: Edza, nemienzaniso mutebhura, chirevo chekuti quotient inoramba yakafanana kunyange kana dividend ne divisor zvachinjwa pamwe chete, uye utaure kusahadzika kunoramba kuripo kunyange mienzaniso ichiwedzera nemamiriro apo chirevo chichishanda (nhamba imwechete isiri 0).
y-m-16-01.material:
Hajun akati, “Zviri nyore kuverenga kana ukawanza dividend ne divisor zvose ne 10. 4.8 ÷ 0.6 inogona kushandurwa kuita 48 ÷ 6, uye quotient inoramba yakafanana. Kwete 10 chete, asi kana ukawanza nenhamba chero ipi yakafanana, quotient inoramba yakafanana!” Hajun akagadzira tebhura iri pazasi. (4.8 inoverengwa ‘four point eight’ uye 0.6 inoverengwa ‘zero point six.’)

1 / 4.8 / 0.6 / 8
10 / 48 / 6 / 8
100 / 480 / 60 / 8
5 / 24 / 3 / 8

y-m-16-01.s.s1.o.a: Quotient yaiva 8 ka4 dzose, saka ikozvino ndinovimbawo ne 'nhamba chero ipi' uye ndinotonga kuti hapana chikonzero chekuedza zvakawanda
y-m-16-01.s.s1.r.a: Wakasimbisa ‘nhamba chero ipi’ nekuti mienzaniso mina yose yakarurama. Tarisa marudzi enhamba anoonekwa mutebhura uye kana pane marudzi asina kuonekwa.
y-m-16-01.s.s1.o.b: Kuwanza kunoita kuti nhamba dzikure, saka quotient inoratidzika kuti ichakura, uye chirevo chaHajun chinoratidzika chakaipa
y-m-16-01.s.s1.r.b: Hazvisi dividend chete yakakura; divisor yakakurawo. Tanga watarisa kuti quotient yakachinja sei mutebhura.
y-m-16-01.s.s1.o.c: Tebhura ine 4.8 ÷ 0.6 chete, saka ndichatonga mushure mekuwana kana inoshandawo kune mamwe ma division
y-m-16-01.s.s1.r.c: Wakaratidza kuti tebhura inobata division imwe chete. Zvaizonaka zvakare kutarisa marudzi ema multipliers.
y-m-16-01.s.s1.o.d: Zvinoratidzika zvakarurama kusvikira zvino, asi nhamba dzakawanzwa dzaiva natural numbers chete, saka ndinoda kuedza marudzi mamwe enhamba

y-m-16-06.title: Kunyora zvakare chiziviso chekugovanisa hupfu zvakaenzana
y-m-16-06.topic: Kugovanisa madhesimali: kusarudza nzvimbo kana quotient ichishandiswa sekufungidzira
y-m-16-06.goal: Sarudza kuti quotient isingapere inofanira kunyorwa kunzvimbo ipi, kuti ienderane nemamiriro enyaya (mamaki echiyero, huwandu hunosara), uye unyore zvakare chiziviso kuti munhu anochigamuchira anzwisise.
y-m-16-06.material:
Pakakwikwidzano yekubika, 7 kg yehupfu inofanira kugovanisirwa zvakaenzana kumateam 3. Chiyero chinogona kuyera kusvika ku0.01 kg (10 g). 7 ÷ 3 i2.3333…, isingapere. Hupfu hunosara mushure mekuti team imwe neimwe yatora hwatorwa nemubatsiri anotarisira. Mubatsiri Mina akanyora chinyorwa chekutanga chechiziviso.
Chinyorwa chekutanga: “Team imwe neimwe, ndapota tora 2.3 kg yehupfu.”
y-m-16-06.prereq.0: Kuwanza nekugovanisa nenhamba dzine nzvimbo mbiri dzedhesimali dzakawanda
y-m-16-06.s.s1.prompt: Chii chinoitika kana team imwe neimwe yapiwa 2.3 kg sezvakaita muchinyorwa chekutanga?
y-m-16-06.s.s1.hint.0: Wanza huwandu hweteam imwe nenhamba yemateam kuwana huwandu hwatorwa nemateam matatu.
y-m-16-06.s.s1.hint.1: Enzanisa huwandu ne7 kg uye uongorore kana pasina kukwana kana kuti hunosara.
y-m-16-06.s.s1.o.a: Hupfu hunotorwa nemateam matatu hunopfuura 7 kg, saka hupfu hunoshoma
y-m-16-06.s.s1.r.a: Kana ukaverenga 2.3 × 3, iri pasi pe7. Iwanze iwe amene kuti uongorore kana pasina kukwana kana kuti hunosara.
y-m-16-06.s.s1.o.b: Huwandu hunotorwa nemateam matatu i7 kg chaiyo, saka hapana chinosara
y-m-16-06.s.s1.r.b: Verenga iwe amene kana kuwedzera 2.3 kg katatu kunoita 7.
y-m-16-06.s.s1.o.c: Huwandu hunotorwa nemateam matatu i6.9 kg, saka 0.1 kg inosara
y-m-16-06.s.s1.r.c: Wakawanza huwandu hweteam imwe nenhamba yemateam kuwana huwandu hwakatorwa, ukauenzanisa ne7 kg.
y-m-16-06.s.s1.o.d: Team imwe ichawana zvishoma, saka huwandu hunosiyana neteam
y-m-16-06.s.s1.r.d: Zvakasarudzwa kuti mateam ose atore huwandu hwakafanana. Fungidzira kuti nei, kunyange nehuwandu hwakafanana, huwandu hwose hunogona kusakwana.
y-m-16-06.s.s1.explain: 2.3 × 3 = 6.9, saka kubva pa7 kg 6.9 kg chete inobuda uye 0.1 kg (100 g) inosara. Kana chiyero chikagona kuyera kusvika ku0.01 kg, unogona kugovanisa nenzira yakanyanya kunaka.
y-m-16-06.s.s2.prompt: Sarudza huwandu q kg weteam imwe seyakagonekwa kuyerwa nechiyero (kunzvimbo mbiri dzedhesimali). Wana 2 kana kupfuura kukosha kwakasiyana kwe q umo huwandu hwakatorwa nemateam matatu husingapfuure 7 kg uye hupfu hunosara hunova 0.08 kg (80 g) kana pasi.
y-m-16-06.s.s2.hint.0: Tanga wagadzika q pa2.3 uye uwane mugove wemateam matatu nehuwandu hunosara, wobva wachinja q ne0.01 imwe panguva uone kuti inochinja sei.
y-m-16-06.s.s2.hint.1: Kana wasvika panyaya umo huwandu hwakatorwa nemateam matatu hunopfuura 7, isa chete kukosha kusvika pamberi payo samakandidate.
y-m-16-06.s.s2.ok.c1: Huwandu une nzvimbo kusvika mbiri dzedhesimali.
y-m-16-06.s.s2.fail.c1: Unyore sehuwandu une nzvimbo kusvika mbiri dzedhesimali, hunogona kuyerwa nechiyero.
y-m-16-06.s.s2.ok.c2: Huwandu hunotorwa nemateam matatu husingapfuure 7 kg.
y-m-16-06.s.s2.fail.c2: Huwandu hunotorwa nemateam matatu hunopfuura 7 kg. Hapana hupfu hwakakwana.
y-m-16-06.s.s2.ok.c3: Hupfu hunosara hunova 0.08 kg kana pasi.
y-m-16-06.s.s2.fail.c3: Hupfu hunosara hupfuura 0.08 kg. Edza kuwedzera huwandu hweteam imwe zvishoma.
y-m-16-06.s.s2.explain: 2.31, 2.32, ne2.33 kg zvose zvinokodzera mamiriro. 3 × 2.31 = 6.93 (hunosara 0.07 kg), 3 × 2.32 = 6.96 (0.04 kg), uye 3 × 2.33 = 6.99 (0.01 kg). Ne2.3 hunosara hunova 0.1 kg, uye 2.34 inopa 7.02 kg, hunova hwakawandisa.
y-m-16-06.s.s3.prompt: Panzvimbo yechinyorwa chekutanga, nyora zvakare chiziviso chinofanira kuverengerwa mutungamiri vemateam. Taura chaizvo huwandu hwehupfu hweteam imwe, uye wedzera mumutsara mumwe kana miviri kuti nei wakasarudza huwandu uhwu panzvimbo pe2.3 kg.
y-m-16-06.s.s3.hint.0: Tanga wanyora ruzivo rwunodiwa nemutungamiri weteam anoverenga chiziviso (kuti atore zvakawanda sei).
y-m-16-06.s.s3.hint.1: Pachikonzero, ratidza kamwe nenhamba huwandu hwakatorwa nemateam matatu nehuwandu hunosara.

y-m-16-06.s.s3.selfAssess.0: Huwandu hwakajeka here, kuti mutungamiri weteam averenge ndokuyera nekutora huwandu hwakafanana nekukurumidza?
y-m-16-06.s.s3.selfAssess.1: Wakatsanangura musiyano pakati pe2.3 kg nehuwandu hwawakanyora uchishandisa huwandu hwose kana hunosara here?
y-m-16-06.s.s3.selfAssess.2: Wakanyora nemashoko anganzwisiswa nevanonzwa kunyange vana here?
y-m-16-06.s.s3.model.0: Team imwe neimwe, ndapota tora 2.33 kg yehupfu. Kana ukayera kunzvimbo mbiri dzedhesimali, mateam matatu pamwe chete anotora 6.99 kg uye hapana chinosara zvakanyanya. Ne2.3 kg imwe neimwe, 0.1 kg inosara.
y-m-16-06.s.s3.model.1: Huwandu hwehupfu hunotorwa neteam imwe i2.31 kg. Kana ukaita izvi, mateam matatu pamwe chete anotora 6.93 kg, husingapfuure 7 kg, uye hunosara i0.07 kg chete.
y-m-16-06.s.s3.modelNote.1: Kukosha kwakasiyana nekwakaitwa rounding (2.33), sa2.31, kunokodzerawo kana kuchienderana nemamiriro.
